friction.definition: The small resistance between wanting something and getting it, which slows consumption and quietly trains patience.
friction.example: Every plan met friction: the weather, the delay, the wrong order.

mia_straw_man.definition: An argument that nobody made, set up so that it can be knocked down easily.
mia_straw_man.example: So you want to drop the whole project was a straw man; the speaker had only said the schedule was short.

psy_foot_in_the_door.definition: A small, easy agreement that is used later as the reason for a much larger one.
psy_foot_in_the_door.example: The free trial was the foot in the door: the yearly contract came next.

side_effect.definition: Any effect the medicine has other than the one it is meant to produce.
side_effect.example: Nausea is listed as a side effect, and it usually passes after the first few days.

symptom.definition: Something you notice and describe yourself: pain, dizziness, a cough, a lump.
symptom.example: The main symptom is the pain, and it has been there for three weeks.
